items.title: Under President Trump’s Leadership, USCIS Takes Unprecedented 2.2 Million Enforcement Actions Protecting Americans Across the Nation
items.summary: Under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump and Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin, U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services is delivering on the Administration’s agenda and putting the American people first.

items.title: Suburban Chicago Man Sentenced for Staging Robberies to Help Others Fraudulently Apply for Immigration Visas
items.summary: A suburban Chicago man has been sentenced to two years in federal prison for conspiring to stage armed robberies so purported victims could apply for U.S. immigration visas reserved for crime victims.

items.title: Litigation-Related Update: Sileiri Doe Class Members May Request Reopening or Reconsideration of an Adverse Decision Without a Fee

items.title: Aliens in Idaho Charged for Illegal Voting
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services assisted an investigation that resulted in charges against two Canadian aliens residing in eastern Idaho for unlawfully voting in the 2022 general election.

items.title: Grocery Store Manager Convicted of Immigration Document Fraud, Obstruction of Two Federal Labor Investigations, and Conspiracy
items.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided pivotal assistance to the case resulting in the conviction of Karla Montoya, 45, of Sacramento.

items.title: Six Charged in Large-Scale Marriage Fraud Ring
items.summary: Six individuals in Massachusetts have been charged with allegedly arranging sham marriages to fraudulently obtain immigration status for illegal aliens.

items.title: Alien from South Africa Charged with Unlawful Voting
items.summary: A South African alien and lawful permanent resident was charged with unlawfully voting in the November 2024 federal election. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services provided valuable assistance during the investigation.

items.title: Canadian Alien Charged with Illegal Voting
items.summary: A grand jury returned an indictment charging Sandra Madeline Watson, 59, of Louisville, with illegal voting by an alien in a federal election.
